edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant Delmar shall pay Plaintiff Harrow USD 1,000,000 within ten (10) business days after this Agreement is executed by both parties. The releases in Section 2 shall become effective only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the payment in cleared funds.

2. RELEASE. In this Agreement, “Released Parties” means, with respect to each of Harrow and Delmar, that party and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, successors, assigns, and each of their respective past and present officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, and representatives. “Released Claims” means all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, and obligations, whether known or unknown, that arise out of or relate to the dispute between Harrow and Delmar or the facts and circumstances alleged in connection with that dispute, through the date this Agreement is executed. Upon receipt by Harrow of the payment in cleared funds as provided in Section 1, Harrow, for itself and its successors and assigns, releases the Released Parties associated with Delmar from all Released Claims. Upon that same receipt, Delmar, for itself and its successors and assigns, releases the Released Parties associated with Harrow from all Released Claims. Nothing in this Section releases a party's obligations under this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Harrow and Delmar shall each keep confidential the existence and terms of this Agreement and shall not disclose them to any person except to its attorneys, accountants, insurers, auditors, and other professional advisers who are bound by duties of confidentiality; as required by law, regulation, court order, or governmental process; or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party making a disclosure required by law or process shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice.
